content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Technician at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification, experience, and age criteria specified in the official notification: Essential Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics and Telecommunication, Mechanical, Mechatronics Engineering or other relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or a CGPA of 5.0 on a 10.00 scale; OR Engineering Diploma in the same disciplines with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate or a CGPA of 5.0 on a 10.00 point scale; OR Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with at least 50% marks and an ITI Course of one year or higher duration in the specified engineering trades; OR Secondary (10) with at least 60% marks and an ITI Certificate of 2 years duration in the specified engineering trades. Good knowledge of computer applications (emails, word processing, spreadsheet, presentations software, and OS like MS-Windows) is also required. Experience (Required): 6 months, preferably in a Tinkering Lab or similar environment. Desirable Experience: 1 year or more in a Tinkering Lab or similar. Age Limit: Up to 30 years.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The technician will assist in operating and handling equipment under proper supervision, helping students connect theoretical concepts with practical applications. Responsibilities include improving technical skills, safety awareness, problem-solving ability, and confidence in using engineering tools. The role involves managing lab work and machine-based activities in Work Studio-1, Work Studio-2, and Maker Space for the Unified Engineering Course. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Technician
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at Apply Online on behalf of the outsource agency. Submit the online application latest by 27 October 2026. Ensure complete and accurate information is provided, as incomplete submissions will be summarily rejected. Be prepared to provide proof of 10th or equivalent, graduation, post-graduation, Ph.D. (if any), experience, and last salary drawn during document verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview or trade test. Fulfilling minimum qualifications does not ensure shortlisting, and higher criteria may be adopted to call a reasonable number of candidates. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification during the Trade Test/Interaction; without original certificates, candidates will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for IIT Jammu Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is this position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: This is a purely temporary engagement for an initial period of 3 months or as per requirement, extendable based on performance, and does not entitle any claim for regularization against a regular post at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the selection process for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates, followed by a trade test and interaction/interview where original documents must be presented for verification.

faq.question: Q4. Through which agency will the selected candidate be deputed?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be deputed at IIT Jammu on an outsource basis by M/s Nimbus Harbor Pvt. Ltd.
